operatorAccount.loadFailed: Could not load account info. Please try again.

email.sentHint: A code was sent to {target}. Enter it to finish verification.

password.title: Password
password.hint: At least 12 characters. Other devices must sign in again after the change.
password.mismatch: The new passwords do not match.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.hint: Use an authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator) to generate a rotating code as a second factor at sign-in.
mfa.scanHint: Scan the QR with your authenticator app, or enter the secret manually, then type the generated 6-digit code.
mfa.recoveryHint: Save these recovery codes now (shown only once). Use one to sign in if your authenticator is unavailable.

security.title: Security
security.passkeysHint: Sign in with device biometrics or a security key instead of a password.
security.pending: Self-service for MFA is coming soon.

destructive.blocked: Preconditions not met — resolve the items marked above first.

passkeys.sectionDescription: Use one instead of a verification code when signing in to the operations console. An account can register several, so switching devices does not mean unbinding first.
passkeys.emptyDescription: Add one and you can sign in to the operations console with a fingerprint, your face, or a security key.
passkeys.consequenceLast: This is the last passkey on the account. Once it is gone you will not be able to sign in with a fingerprint, your face, or a security key. If this account is required to use passkeys, the server will refuse this deletion.
passkeys.consequenceOther: The key stops working immediately and can no longer be used to sign in; the other passkeys on the account are unaffected. A deleted key cannot be recovered — you would have to register a new one.
